body: Baraka (S005) taking the full tree-wide strip of ledger citation vocabulary from product files, per the backlog row assigned yesterday and confirmed on the event trail. Scope: every tracked file outside .context_ledger/ except two documented exemptions (generated agent-entrypoint digests AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and the app's own runtime context data under backend/data/.context/, both handled by documented override or manual rewrite). Classes: ADR numbers, ledger bug IDs, ledger paths, "per ADR", plus the missed classes named in the claim: Session N / S-codename references, lowercase adr refs, ledger review numbers, feature labels, and token-bearing test filenames (renamed via git mv). Scripted bulk pass with per-line review log; zero expected lint residue outside the exempt set. No behavior change — comments, docstrings, and test names only; full exit gate proves it.
